title: Read a route value
summary: Fiber: Read a route value. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: Params reads a named path part. Open GET /hello/Ravi. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read a route value with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Read a route value
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/hello/:name", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Hi, " + c.Params("name") + "!") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: Params reads the name segment Ravi, which is joined into a greeting.
